tiers.label: Digger
tiers.blurb: The first marks in the burrow. Reviews, issues, translations and small fixes all count.

tiers.label: Foreman
tiers.blurb: A steady hand on the framework: merged work, reviews and documentation that others build on.

tiers.label: Burrow Engineer
tiers.blurb: Sustained, cross-cutting contribution — controls, RFCs, translations, reviews and community work.

merged_pr.label: Merged pull request
merged_pr.source: cached GitHub contributions or GraphQL merged PRs
merged_pr.description: A merged pull request in the framework repository. The offline cache is used as a conservative proxy; GraphQL replaces it with the exact merged-PR count when a token is present.

review.label: Pull-request review
review.description: A substantive review on someone else's pull request. Self-reviews do not count.

issue_triage.label: Issue triage
issue_triage.description: An issue assigned to and handled by the contributor.

docs.label: Documentation
docs.description: Merged documentation work, including the framework docs and this website.

translation.label: Translation
translation.description: Merged translations of docs, pages or release notes.

controls_rfc.label: Controls or RFC work
controls_rfc.source: GitHub GraphQL (merged PRs labelled area:controls / area:rfc)
controls_rfc.description: A merged control change or an accepted RFC authored by the contributor.

talk_session.label: Talk or session
talk_session.description: A conference talk, workshop or community session. Recorded by a maintainer with a reason; never inferred.
